# Charlotta

## Overview

- **Age:** Fourteen years old (initially)  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v4 c3 P42](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0042)</sub>
- **Origin:** Boston (later moved to)  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v3 c7 P48](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0048)</sub>
- **Role:** Handmaiden at Echo Lodge  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c27 P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043)</sub>
- **Titles:** Charlotta the Fourth  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Charlotta the Fourth  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>

## Appearance

Charlotta has a freckled face, a snubbed nose, and a wide mouth with a fearfully wide, cheerful smile. She originally wore very large blue bows in her hair, though she eventually abandoned them when she grew into young womanhood and adopted an enormous pompadour hairstyle.

_Sources: [v2 c23 P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), [v2 c28 P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048), [v3 c23 P7](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0007), [v4 c3 P37](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0037)_

## Personality

Warm-hearted, cheerful, and intensely loyal, Charlotta is utterly devoted to her employer, Miss Lavendar, and deeply admires Anne Shirley. She is good-tempered, eager to please, and never criticizes Miss Lavendar's imaginative pretendings. Although somewhat prone to clumsiness and self-conscious about her lack of patience with men, she holds affection and care for those she serves.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c23 P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), [v2 c27 P39](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0039), [v2 c27 P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 c27 P44](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0044), [v2 c28 P55](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0055)_

- Devoted and loyal  <sub>[v2 c23 P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), [v2 c27 P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043)</sub>
- Warm-hearted and cheerful  <sub>[v2 c27 P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 c27 P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043)</sub>

- Domestic handmaiden skills (basting, sweeping, weeding, raking)  <sub>[v2 c27 P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 c28 P18](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0018)</sub>

## Goals

- To care for and look after Miss Lavendar  <sub>[v2 c27 P44](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0044), [v2 c28 P55](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0055)</sub>
- To imitate Anne Shirley's posture and mannerisms  <sub>[v2 c27 P39](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0039)</sub>

## History

Leonora Bowman, nicknamed Charlotta the Fourth by Miss Lavendar Lewis, came to live at Echo Lodge at age fourteen to work as Miss Lavendar's handmaiden following her three elder sisters. She developed a deep adoration for her mistress and became fond of Anne Shirley and Diana Barry during their frequent visits to the lodge. Worried about Miss Lavendar's health and lonely future, she actively supported Anne's efforts to help Miss Lavendar and rejoiced when Miss Lavendar married Mr. Stephen Irving. Following the wedding, she moved with the Irvings to Boston, though she initially experienced severe homesickness. She matured into a young lady, discarded her oversized blue hair bows, and eventually married a good-tempered bricklayer named Tom. Later, she returned to attend Anne's wedding, enthusiastically throwing rice and old shoes to wish the bride good luck.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c23 P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), [v2 c27 P44](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0044), [v2 c28 P55](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0055), [v3 c7 P48](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0048), [v3 c23 P1](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0001), [v3 c23 P7](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0007), [v4 c3 P42](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0042), [v4 c4 P16](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0016)_

## Background by volume

- Her real name is Leonora Bowman  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- She is the fourth sister in her family to work for Miss Lavendar, earning her nickname Charlotta the Fourth  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- Her sisters were named Charlotta, Julietta, and Evelina  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>

## Quotes

> Miss Lavendar isn’t well, Miss Shirley, ma’am. I’m sure she isn’t, though she never complains.  <sub>[v2 c27 P44](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0044)</sub>

> Please, Miss Shirley, ma’am, it’s plain to be seen you and Miss Lavendar have got a secret and I think, begging your pardon if I’m too forward, Miss Shirley, ma’am, that it’s real mean not to tell me when we’ve all been such chums.  <sub>[v2 c28 P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048)</sub>

> I hope that he’ll marry Miss Lavendar. Some women’s intended from the start to be old maids, and I’m afraid I’m one of them, Miss Shirley, ma’am, because I’ve awful little patience with the men.  <sub>[v2 c28 P55](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0055)</sub>

> Goodness, no, Miss Shirley, ma’am. I wouldn’t know who he meant if he did. Of course, when we got married he had to say, 'I take thee, Leonora,’ and I declare to you, Miss Shirley, ma’am, I’ve had the most dreadful feeling ever since that it wasn’t me he was talking to and I haven’t been rightly married at all.  <sub>[v4 c3 P42](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0042)</sub>

> Tom is only a bricklayer, but he’s real good-tempered. When I said to him, says I, 'Tom, can I go to Miss Shirley’s wedding? I mean to go anyhow, but I’d like to have your consent,’ he just says, 'Suit yourself, Charlotta, and you’ll suit me.’ That’s a real pleasant kind of husband to have, Miss Shirley, ma’am.  <sub>[v4 c3 P42](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0042)</sub>
